title: R&D contract example; copy and customize before use
target: An explicitly authorized artifact or experiment
change: Run one authorized comparison and report evidence to the lead
constraints: Example only. Preserve originals. No generation or GPU work without task authorization.
ownership: Worker owns only its named report and new iteration output directory

review.skip_reason: Replace with: measurement only, no code change (or add review reports)

acceptance: Report exact inputs, outputs, fixed conditions, metrics and unverified quality; no automatic pass

workflow.approval: Replace with the date and the user's words that started R&D and confirmed the models

quality.agent: Replace with the quality agent (another origin)

criteria: Replace with observable acceptance thresholds agreed with the user
workflow.baseline: Replace with the reference artifact and its hash, or the first-baseline plan
controls: Replace with fixed camera, resolution, data, seed, hardware and quality budget as applicable
stop_conditions: Repeated defect or conflicting evidence requires user judgment
